name: Rinnai multi head system
tagline: One outdoor unit heats or cools up to six rooms, each controlled separately.
summary: The Rinnai Inverter Multi Split System connects up to six indoor units to a single outdoor unit, saving outdoor space. Each room is controlled individually, so you only heat or cool the rooms you need.
Five outdoor unit sizes pair with wall mounted, slim ducted, compact cassette and floor console indoor units.

image.alt: Rinnai multi head system outdoor unit with four wall-mounted indoor units

highlights.title: Up to six rooms
highlights.text: One outdoor unit runs up to six individually controlled indoor units.

highlights.title: Four indoor types
highlights.text: Mix wall mounted, slim ducted, compact cassette and floor console units in one system.

highlights.title: Wi-Fi control
highlights.text: Wi-Fi is standard on wall mounted, floor console and cassette units, and optional on slim ducted.

highlights.title: 3D DC inverter
highlights.text: Three DC motors work together for a faster warm-up or cool-down and higher efficiency.

highlights.title: DRED enabled
highlights.text: Lets your electricity provider manage the system's demand on the grid during peak periods.

highlights.title: Timer and auto restart
highlights.text: Set on and off times, and the system restarts by itself after a power outage.

specs.label: Maximum total pipe length
specs.value: 60 m to 80 m, depending on model
